subject: A landslide named Azad-Owaisi on the road to 2027
alt: Satish Acharya’s cartoon: under a blue sky a road climbs a slope. On the left, Akhilesh Yadav, in a red cap, white kurta, black waistcoat and white pyjamas, rides a bicycle uphill; his face is alarmed and sweat flies off him. At the roadside a wooden arrow sign reads UP 2027. On the right a huge pile of grey boulders has slid down the hillside and blocks the road. Out of the same hillside rise two enormous faces, Chandrashekhar Azad and Asaduddin Owaisi: Azad wears glasses and a thick moustache, Owaisi a white skullcap, glasses and a thick beard. A thick red arrow on the rubble points to the right. At the lower right is a newspaper cutting: UP ELECTIONS - AZAD & OWAISI ALLIANCE. The cartoonist’s signature, SATISH ACHARYA, is at the lower left.
chutki: Akhilesh Yadav, in his red cap and black waistcoat, is pedalling up the slope towards a wooden sign that says UP 2027. The road ahead has disappeared under a landslide of grey boulders, and out of the hillside above it rise two enormous faces, Chandrashekhar Azad and Asaduddin Owaisi. In the corner, a newspaper cutting announces the day’s news: UP ELECTIONS - AZAD & OWAISI ALLIANCE.

The needle is in the shape of the obstacle. The alliance is not drawn as a fellow traveller on the road but as the mountain that has come down on it; the cycle can push as hard as it likes, the road is gone. And the two faces look down from the slope while the red arrow points into the rubble - 2027 is no longer a question of who will walk together, but of who has blocked the way.
